capabilities: sign in with a one-time email code
list purchased Santi Younger plugins and themes
install catalog products into the vault
check for and apply plugin and theme updates
auto-update installed catalog plugins after Obsidian loads
disambiguation: Not a purchase tool; purchases happen on platform.santiyounger.com and the plugin only installs and updates products already tied to your account.
extras: Distributes outside the community directory via BRAT; discloses network endpoints (platform.santiyounger.com, GitHub releases, a CDN), says no telemetry, and warns that installed catalog plugins have their own terms and may not be community-reviewed.
problem: Obsidian's community plugin directory cannot deliver paid catalog products, so buyers of Santi Younger plugins have no built-in way to install or update them inside the app.

relations.evidence: Install this plugin with BRAT (Beta Reviewers Auto-update Tester), a community plugin that installs and updates

requires.name: Santi Younger platform account (email one-time code)
prior purchase of each Santi Younger plugin or theme

summary: Account-linked installer and updater for paid Santi Younger plugins and themes, accessed after one-time email-code sign-in.
